phase: P6 step 1: SDL3 backend on macOS

build.sdl: NTSD_SDL=1 (manifest flag; default builds unchanged), NTSD_SDL_PREFIX default /opt/homebrew/opt/sdl3 (Homebrew SDL3 3.4.16, video driver cocoa)
build.appkit: app_e2e build: swift-build --scratch-path build/swiftpm-app -c release --product NTSDNative

host.windows: SDL window + renderer + streaming XRGB8888 texture (nearest); full-screen popup = SDL fullscreen (Spaces off), image scaled to fit; windowed client from the reported metrics, centred like the headless host
host.metrics: macOS: the AppKit window host's SM_CXFIXEDFRAME/SM_CYFIXEDFRAME/SM_CYCAPTION (SDL_GetWindowBordersSize is unsupported on Cocoa: probe returned false); display bounds via SDL 3008x1692 scale 1.0, same as AppKit
host.input: SDL scancodes mapped onto the existing macOS key-code table (one VK/scan/extended definition); Caps Lock as a whole press per toggle on macOS like the AppKit host; mouse client points with scale-to-fit; gamepads (first two at launch, 25 ms sampling) mapped like the AppKit controller host
host.audio: SDL audio stream fed by OriginalMacSoundEffects.render at the device rate; gain 0 while muted or unfocused (DirectSound focus)
host.music: silent, manifest durations (OriginalRuntimeSilentMusicPlayer), declared until P7 decoding
host.text: macOS: the AppKit host's CoreText masks; elsewhere blank masks (declared)
host.other: SDL message boxes; on macOS the Darwin Winsock and the standard overlay, elsewhere --no-network and SDL_GetPrefPath

runtime: WindowLease.presented keeps the last presented crop; OriginalFramebufferPNG writes it identically on every host (--body-frames DIR, --body-frame-every N, script 'frame PATH'); silent manifest music and the PNG encoder moved from NTSDHeadless into NTSDRuntime
